## iOS: CYLLiquidGlass

| 中文 | English |
|:--|:--|
| CocoaPods pod 与 Swift Package 库 `CYLLiquidGlass`（`import CYLLiquidGlass`，Objective-C：`@import CYLLiquidGlass;`），iOS 15 起，同仓库同版本。 | CocoaPods pod and Swift package library `CYLLiquidGlass` (`import CYLLiquidGlass`, Objective-C: `@import CYLLiquidGlass;`), iOS 15 and later, same repository and version. |
| `CYLLiquidGlass.isActive()`：系统是否使用液态玻璃：iOS 27 及以上总是；iOS 26 上 App 未设置 `UIDesignRequiresCompatibility` 时；更早的系统为 false。只读取一次。TabBar 的 `CYLUtils.isLiquidGlassActive()` 转发到它，接口不变。 | `CYLLiquidGlass.isActive()`: whether the system draws Liquid Glass: iOS 27 and later always; iOS 26 unless the app sets `UIDesignRequiresCompatibility`; false on earlier systems. Read once. The tab bar's `CYLUtils.isLiquidGlassActive()` forwards to it, its API unchanged. |
| `CYLLiquidGlassView`：任意视图的玻璃背景，`UIVisualEffectView` + `UIGlassEffect`；`glassTintColor` 着色，`cornerRadius` 裁剪；不接收触摸、对辅助功能隐藏。`isGlassDrawn` 为 false（无玻璃的系统）时不绘制，调用方保持扁平背景。 | `CYLLiquidGlassView`: a glass background for any view, a `UIVisualEffectView` with a `UIGlassEffect`; `glassTintColor` tints it and `cornerRadius` clips it; it takes no touches and is hidden from accessibility. When `isGlassDrawn` is false (a system without glass) it draws nothing and the caller keeps its flat background. |
| 测试：`CYLLiquidGlass.activeOverride` 替换系统判断。 | Tests: `CYLLiquidGlass.activeOverride` replaces the system check. |

```swift
import CYLLiquidGlass

let glass = CYLLiquidGlassView()
glass.glassTintColor = UIColor.systemOrange.withAlphaComponent(0.4)
glass.cornerRadius = 12
glass.frame = tagView.bounds
tagView.insertSubview(glass, at: 0)
if !glass.isGlassDrawn {
    tagView.backgroundColor = .systemOrange   // the flat fallback
}
```

## Android: `:cylliquidglass`

| 中文 | English |
|:--|:--|
| Maven 构件 `io.github.chenyilong:cyltabbarcontroller-liquidglass`（模块 `:cylliquidglass`，包 `com.cyl.liquidglass`），API 23 起；TabBar（`:cyltabbar`）依赖它，反之不成立。TabBar 绘制的 AGSL 玻璃（背景、效果、高光、弹簧，移植自 Kyant 的 Backdrop，Apache-2.0）移入本模块。 | Maven artifact `io.github.chenyilong:cyltabbarcontroller-liquidglass` (module `:cylliquidglass`, package `com.cyl.liquidglass`), API 23 and later; the tab bar (`:cyltabbar`) depends on it, not the reverse. The AGSL glass the tab bar draws (backdrop, effects, highlight, springs, ported from Kyant's Backdrop, Apache-2.0) moved into this module. |
| `CYLLiquidGlass.isActive()`（与 iOS 同名）：Android 12 及以上为 true（Android 13+ 完整玻璃含折射，Android 12 只有模糊，与 TabBar 相同）；更早的版本为 false，调用方保持扁平背景。`CYLLiquidGlass.activeOverride` 供测试替换。 | `CYLLiquidGlass.isActive()` (the same name as iOS): true on Android 12 and later (Android 13+ the full glass with refraction, Android 12 the blur only, as the tab bar); false on older versions, where callers keep a flat background. `CYLLiquidGlass.activeOverride` replaces it in tests. |
| `CYLLiquidGlassView`（与 iOS 同名）：任意视图的玻璃背景，`glassTintColor`（ARGB `Int?`）、`cornerRadius`（px）、`backdropSource`（玻璃后面绘制的视图，默认窗口视图根）、只读 `isGlassDrawn`、`applyEffect()`；不接收触摸、对辅助功能隐藏；玻璃里不嵌玻璃。 | `CYLLiquidGlassView` (the same name as iOS): a glass background for any view: `glassTintColor` (ARGB `Int?`), `cornerRadius` (px), `backdropSource` (the view drawn behind the glass, the window's view root by default), read-only `isGlassDrawn`, `applyEffect()`; it takes no touches and is hidden from accessibility; no glass inside glass. |
| 已知限制：每个玻璃视图各自录制 `backdropSource`；标签很多时应提供共享的背景（性能 TODO，需在设备上测量帧耗时）。 | Known limit: every glass view records `backdropSource` itself; with many tags a shared backdrop should be supplied (performance TODO: measure frame time on a device). |

## HarmonyOS: `cylliquidglass`

| 中文 | English |
|:--|:--|
| ohpm 包 `cylliquidglass`（HAR 模块，`import { CYLLiquidGlass, CYLLiquidGlassView } from 'cylliquidglass'`）；TabBar（`cyltabbar`）依赖它，反之不成立。TabBar 的玻璃材质 `CYLLiquidGlassMaterial` 与玻璃胶囊 `CYLLiquidGlassCapsuleModifier` 移入本包（`cyltabbar` 重新导出，导入不变）。 | ohpm package `cylliquidglass` (a HAR module, `import { CYLLiquidGlass, CYLLiquidGlassView } from 'cylliquidglass'`); the tab bar (`cyltabbar`) depends on it, not the reverse. The tab bar's glass material `CYLLiquidGlassMaterial` and glass capsule `CYLLiquidGlassCapsuleModifier` moved into it (`cyltabbar` re-exports them, so its imports are unchanged). |
| `CYLLiquidGlass.isActive()`（与 iOS、Android 同名）：鸿蒙上始终为真（TabBar 在每个受支持的 API 上都绘制模糊仿制，系统材质从 API 24 起替代它）；`CYLLiquidGlass.activeOverride` 供测试替换。 | `CYLLiquidGlass.isActive()` (the same name as iOS and Android): always true on HarmonyOS (the tab bar draws the blur imitation on every supported API, the system material replaces it from API 24); `CYLLiquidGlass.activeOverride` replaces it in tests. |
| `CYLLiquidGlassView`（与 iOS、Android 同名的组件）：任意组件的玻璃背景，放在 `Stack` 中内容之后：`glassTintColor`（颜色字符串，'' 为不着色）、`cornerRadius`（vp）、`dark`；不接收触摸，对辅助功能隐藏。`isGlassDrawn` 在鸿蒙上就是 `CYLLiquidGlass.isActive()`：为 false 时调用方不创建该视图。 | `CYLLiquidGlassView` (a component named as on iOS and Android): a glass background for any component, placed behind the content in a `Stack`: `glassTintColor` (a color string, '' for none), `cornerRadius` (vp), `dark`; it takes no touches and is hidden from accessibility. `isGlassDrawn` is `CYLLiquidGlass.isActive()` on HarmonyOS: when false the caller does not create the view. |

## Mini program: `cyl-liquid-glass`

| 中文 | English |
|:--|:--|
| 组件 `cyl-liquid-glass`（`CrossPlatform/wechat-miniprogram-cyltabbar/src/cyl-liquid-glass`，随 `cyl-tabbar-miniprogram` 的 `src` 发布）：任意组件的玻璃背景，放在有定位的父视图内的最前面：`glassTintColor`（CSS 颜色，'' 为不着色）、`cornerRadius`（px）、`isDark`；占满父视图，CSS `backdrop-filter`（模糊 16 px、饱和度 180 %）加半透明着色与顶部高光；不接收触摸，对辅助功能隐藏。数值与 TabBar 的 `cyl-glass-lens` 相同。 | Component `cyl-liquid-glass` (`CrossPlatform/wechat-miniprogram-cyltabbar/src/cyl-liquid-glass`, published in `cyl-tabbar-miniprogram`'s `src`): a glass background for any component, placed first inside a positioned parent: `glassTintColor` (a CSS color, '' for none), `cornerRadius` (px), `isDark`; it fills the parent, CSS `backdrop-filter` (blur 16 px, saturation 180 %) over a translucent tint with a faint top highlight; it takes no touches and is hidden from accessibility. The values are those of the tab bar's `cyl-glass-lens`. |
| `cyl_liquid_glass.js`：`cylLiquidGlassIsActive()`（与 iOS、Android、鸿蒙的 `isActive()` 同名）：小程序中始终为真；WebView 不支持 `backdrop-filter` 时只剩着色，与 TabBar 相同。`cylLiquidGlassSetActiveOverride(value)` 供测试替换；`cylLiquidGlassStyle(tint, radius)` 生成行内样式。组件的 data `isGlassDrawn` 即 `cylLiquidGlassIsActive()`。 | `cyl_liquid_glass.js`: `cylLiquidGlassIsActive()` (the same name as `isActive()` on iOS, Android and HarmonyOS): always true in a mini program; where the WebView lacks `backdrop-filter` only the tint stays, as in the tab bar. `cylLiquidGlassSetActiveOverride(value)` replaces it in tests; `cylLiquidGlassStyle(tint, radius)` builds the inline style. The component's data `isGlassDrawn` is `cylLiquidGlassIsActive()`. |
| 与 `cyl-glass-lens` 不重复：`cyl-glass-lens` 仍是 TabBar 的透镜（滑动、弹入动画），数值按拷贝共用；待 TabBar 会话释放该文件夹后，再让它从本组件取玻璃。 | No duplicate of `cyl-glass-lens`: it stays the tab bar's lens (slide and spring-in animation), the values shared by copy; once the tab bar session releases that folder, it should take its glass from this component. |
